BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the B3-1 Community Shopping
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 32-B in the area bound by:

A line 25.15 feet north of and parallel to East 133rd Street; South Houston Avenue;
East 133° Street; and the public alley next west of and parallel to South Houston
Avenue.

to those of RT-4 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse, and Multi-Unit District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 13258 South Houston Avenue, Chicago, Illinois.
